data.notes: September 2026 is already anchored by Ultra Japan plus several large arena and international touring dates in Tokyo and the Greater Tokyo area.

events.title: Ultra Japan 2026
events.summary: Ultra Japan is confirmed for September 19–20, 2026 at Odaiba Ultra Park. The official ticket page lists 1-day and 2-day passes on sale for the Tokyo edition.

events.title: sakanaction — SAKANAQUARIUM 2026 透明
events.summary: sakanaction’s official tour page lists four September 2026 Tokyo dates at Nippon Budokan: September 8, 9, 18 and 19. The run is part of the band’s SAKANAQUARIUM 2026 arena tour.

events.title: ONE OK ROCK — DETOX JAPAN TOUR FINAL 2026
events.summary: Promoter SOGO TOKYO confirms ONE OK ROCK’s DETOX JAPAN TOUR FINAL 2026 for September 5–6 at ZOZO Marine Stadium in Chiba, very near Tokyo. Both dates list 16:00 doors and 18:00 start.

events.title: Vaundy — ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026 “HORO”
events.summary: Vaundy’s official site confirms the Tokyo-area opening dates of ASIA ARENA TOUR 2026 “HORO” at Makuhari Messe on September 5 and 6, 2026. The announced ticket price is standing ¥9,900.

events.title: Hoshimachi Suisei — HOSHIMACHI SUISEI ARENA TOUR 2026 Once Upon a Stellar
events.summary: Hoshimachi Suisei’s official fan-club ticket page confirms two Yokohama dates at K-Arena Yokohama on September 8 and 9, 2026. The arena tour is titled Once Upon a Stellar.

events.title: Belle & Sebastian — Japan Tour 2026
events.summary: Creativeman confirms Belle & Sebastian’s Tokyo dates at Kanadevia Hall on September 24 and 25, 2026. The September 24 show performs Tigermilk and September 25 performs If You’re Feeling Sinister.

events.title: Rikon Densetsu — 2026 ONEMAN LIVE
events.summary: Ticketing platform eplus lists Rikon Densetsu at Nippon Budokan on September 10 and 11, 2026. The shows are the band’s 2026 ONEMAN LIVE dates.

events.title: The Damned — Final Damnation 50 Japan
events.summary: Creativeman confirms The Damned’s Final Damnation 50 Japan Tokyo show for September 19, 2026 at Toyosu PIT. The page notes that a support act is planned and tickets go on sale May 30.

events.title: Cave of God Eye Vol.7 — The Autumn Rave / Regan Nano Japan Tour 2026
events.summary: Resident Advisor confirms Cave of God Eye Vol.7 at Ooba Camping Village in Tokyo from September 19–20, 2026. The psytrance-focused lineup includes Regan, ATMOS, Atomic Pulse, E-VO, Jikooha, Tomocomo, Ree.K and TSUYOSHI SUZUKI.

events.title: Kuroyume — The Perfect Days to Die
events.summary: Tokyo Garden Theater’s official schedule confirms Kuroyume’s The Perfect Days to Die concert on September 6, 2026. The listing gives 14:30 doors and 16:00 start.

events.title: Mike Stern Band featuring Dennis Chambers, Randy Brecker, Leni Stern & Lincoln Goines
events.summary: A four-night Blue Note Tokyo run from fusion guitarist Mike Stern with heavyweight players Dennis Chambers, Randy Brecker, Leni Stern and Lincoln Goines, aimed at the city’s serious contemporary-jazz and fusion audience.

events.title: 江戸Jazz 2026
events.summary: A contemporary Japanese jazz night staged inside the Kanze Noh Theater at GINZA SIX, bringing together Akira Wada, Shota Watanabe, Ryo Konishi, Mao Sone, Keisuke Furuki, Akira Kudo and kiki vivi lily for a tradition-meets-modern-jazz setting.

events.title: TOKYO MET SaLaD MUSIC FESTIVAL 2026
events.summary: Tokyo Metropolitan Theatre confirms the main program of TOKYO MET SaLaD MUSIC FESTIVAL 2026 for September 11–13, 2026. The festival program includes a main concert, orchestra programming, children’s opera, dance and mini-concerts around Ikebukuro.

events.title: Andrea Motis Guitar Trio "Intimate"
events.summary: Barcelona vocalist and trumpeter Andrea Motis brings her intimate guitar-trio project to Blue Note Tokyo with Josep Traver and Jurandir da Silva, spanning jazz standards, Brazilian repertoire, chanson and folk-inflected material.
